author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Full moon in the top-right corner over a couple: a woman in front with a hair bun and a man behind, their heads resting on shoulder arches that meet in a V as in the reference; the current drawing had two equal floating rings over two arcs under a centred moon, and read as a frowning face.
omissions: The woman's flowing hair and profile are simplified to a round head with a top bun; the moon is smaller than the reference so it stays 8 clear of the man's head.
